anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: Who is the Lord? I do not know, and I will not send Israel away.
Quoted: I will set my throne above the clouds; I will go up into heaven; I will be equal to the Most High.
The god of this age blinding — possible.

pass_a_gloss: And the sacrificing happens in Egypt, a rule of Pharaoh being, the one being according to earth and pressed with darkness, which is ignorance. And those under this one's rule, the ruler of Egypt, are in much ignorance of blindness, and he himself having been housed in is held by glory of his lifting-up, as he said: Who is the Lord? I do not know, and Israel I do not send away, confessing the same with: I will set my throne above the clouds, into heaven I will go up, I will be equal to the Most High.
pass_b_english: And the sacrificing takes place in Egypt, under Pharaoh's rule — the rule that is according to earth and pressed by darkness, which is ignorance. And those under the rule of this ruler of Egypt are in much ignorance of blindness. He himself, having settled in, is held by the glory of his lifting-up, as he said: "Who is the Lord? I do not know, and I will not send Israel away," confessing the same as "I will set my throne above the clouds; I will go up into heaven; I will be equal to the Most High."
source_text: Ἡ δὲ [θ]ύσις γίνεται ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, ἀ[ρχ]ῆς οὔσης Φαραώ, τῇ κατὰ γ[ῆν] οὔσῃ καὶ σκότῳ τεθλιμμ[ένῃ], ἥτις ἐστὶν ἄγνοια. Κ[αὶ οἱ] ὑπὸ τὴν τούτου ἀρχὴν [τοῦ τ]ῆς Αἰγύπτου ἄρχοντος ἐν πολλῇ ἀγνοίᾳ τυφλώσεώς εἰσι, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐνοικισθεὶς κεκράτηται δόξῃ ἐπάρσεως αὐτοῦ, καθὼς εἶπεν· "Τίς ἐστιν ὁ κ(ύριο)ς, οὐ γινώσκω, καὶ τὸν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ οὐκ ἀποστέλλω", ὁμολογῶν τὸ αὐτὸ <τῷ> "θήσω μου τὸν θρόνον ἐπάνω τῶν νεφελῶν, εἰς οὐρανὸν ἀναβήσομαι, ἔσομαι ἴσος τῷ ὑψίστῳ".
